title: Nourish & Flow: Ayurveda + Yoga for Everyday Life
venue_name: 2200 Carrington Street, Unit 100, Richmond, VA, United States, Virginia 23223
description: A grounding, energizing practice that blends mindful movement and breath work with simple, practical wellness rituals drawn from Ayurveda and South Asian living. The goal is to help students feel better in their bodies and more intentional in their day, rather than just move through a sequence.
long_description:
A grounding, energizing practice that blends mindful movement and breath work with simple, practical wellness rituals drawn from Ayurveda and South Asian living. The goal is to help students feel better in their bodies and more intentional in their day, rather than just move through a sequence.
